messages:
sara: Hey, support — customer (AcmePayments) hitting structured JSON failures in prod since this morning. They call our /v1/generate with `json_schema` and sometimes we get a parsing error downstream in their validator. Error shows type mismatch and also some null booleans.

raj: Can you paste request/response sample?

sara: Yes. Customer sent compact prompt + schema. Here's the exact API call they used (sanitized):

curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \\
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_live_XXXX' \\
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\
  -d '{"model":"rwd-instruct-1","json_schema": {"type":"object","properties":{"user_id":{"type":"number"},"active":{"type":"boolean"},"plan":{"type":"string","enum":["FREE","PRO","ENTERPRISE"]}},"required":["user_id","active"]},"prompt":"generate user record"}'

sara: Customer got back this output (trimmed):

{
  "user_id": "1007",
  "active": "false",
  "plan": "pro"
}

sara: Their server-side validator fails because user_id is a string and active is a string, and enum casing doesn't match (`pro` vs `PRO`). They reported ~15% of responses are fine, 85% are broken.

maria: Thanks, this smells like model-side formatting drift rather than our parser always. Do we have recent model rollouts?

tim: We pushed rwd-instruct-1 v2026-03-08 at 04:12 UTC (minor prompt tuning). I see an annotated note: "soft-enforce quoting for safety" but I didn't expect it to stringify numerics.

raj: Repro attempt: I ran the same payload against rwd-instruct-1 stable in sandbox. I got mixed results. Example run 1: valid JSON with number/boolean. Run 2: everything quoted. Looks non-deterministic.

maria: Could be temperature or system prompt change causing model to prefer textual tokens. But our structured output postprocessor should cast simple types. Is that step failing?

support-ops: FYI customer also flagged billing spike due to retries. They retried on parse errors and consumed tokens. Customer asked for credits.

infra-bot: Incident INC-2026-134 created: "structured-output: inconsistent typing causing customer validation failures" assigned to eng-ml, priority P2.

raj: I pulled logs from the JSON parser. The parser emits this trace when coercion fails:

[2026-03-15T11:46:02Z] json_validator.py: coerce_types: value='\"1007\"' target_type=number -> CoercionError
[2026-03-15T11:46:02Z] json_validator.py: coerce_types: value='\"false\"' target_type=boolean -> CoercionError

raj: It looks like the model sometimes wraps primitives in quotes (so the string literal contains quotes) rather than plain tokens. Our coercion expects raw string without extra quotes.

maria: Could the model be emitting a code block? e.g. ````json\n\"1007\"\n```` ? That would explain extra quotes. Any examples with backticks?

sara: I asked the customer for the raw body. They included no fences. The response is a plain JSON object where values are strings.

tim: Hypothesis: earlier we added an intermediate step that wraps any atomic token with quotes to avoid accidental injection when strict_schema=false. A config bug might have flipped for some requests. Search for a rollout flag last week.

raj: I grep'd deploys: a feature flag `structured_json_safe_wrap` was enabled rollout 2026-03-09 for 30% traffic and toggled by routing. Could be a routing mismatch: some requests hit nodes with flag on.

maria: If that's true, easiest mitigation: disable feature flag immediately, then follow-up fix to improve coercion to accept quoted primitives. Can we toggle?

tim: I can flip the flag for production to 0% now. Doing it in 2 mins, will post when done. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

[~2m later]

tim: Flag flipped to 0% for prod. Confirming via canary logs — traffic back to previous path.

raj: I re-ran the customer payload against prod endpoint. First 20 requests all returned correct types. Good sign.

sara: Customer testing in staging says errors dropped to near zero. They're asking for root cause and a permanent fix. Also they requested credit for the extra token usage.

maria: Root cause summary draft: a partial rollout of safety-wrapping logic introduced quoted primitives for some responses, which our current coercion logic didn't handle when values were double-quoted. Fix plan: 1) revert rollout (done), 2) patch coercion to strip wrapping quotes and handle stringified booleans/nulls (eng-ml + eng-runtime), 3) add schema compliance regression tests and an eval set for enum casing normalization or strict-vs-loose modes, 4) update docs on how enum casing is validated.

tim: For (2) I'll open a runtime PR to try safe coercion: when target_is_number and value is string that matches ^\"?[-+]?[0-9]+(\\.[0-9]+)?\"?$ -> cast. For booleans accept (\"true\"|\"false\"|true|false|null). Also add logging so we can count coercions.

raj: We should also add a postprocessor flag to normalize enum casing (upcase by default for schema enum lists) with an option to be strict. That might avoid customer surprises.

support-ops: On credits: recommend offering a one-time credit for # of extra requests * avg_cost until we confirm exact overage. I'm happy to draft email to AcmePayments if you approve.

sara: Yes please draft. Customer is polite but needs quick remediation.

maria: Owners: tim (runtime fix), raj (tests + enum normalizer), sara (customer comms). Timeline: runtime patch today for coercion + feature test; enum normalization and tests in next sprint.

infra-bot: Updated INC-2026-134: status=investigating -> mitigated; owners set -> tim,maria,raj; severity downgraded to P3.

tim: PR created: github.com/redwood/inference/pull/5421 - adds tolerant coercion + metrics. Deploying to canary now.

maria: Great. After canary passes, schedule a gradual rollout with feature flag + metrics threshold. Also add a synthetic eval where schema expects numbers/bools to ensure no regressions.

sara: I'll send the credit proposal and root cause summary to the customer once we confirm canary results. Thanks all :heart:

support-ops: Marking thread for follow-up. If anyone sees more customer reports, ping #support.

maria: Postmortem checklist item: audit any other flags that wrap tokens; add unit tests for quoted-primitive cases.

sara: Closing loop for now — I'll update when customer ack.
